company.shortDescription: Supertone is a top-notch AI audio company with a vision to create a landscape where anyone can speak and be heard in the voice they want.
company.description: Supertone, the catalyst for creative voice, is a top-notch artificial intelligence (AI) audio company with a vision to create a landscape where anyone can speak and be heard in the voice they want. Utilizing cutting-edge voice AI technology specializing in voice separation and synthesis, Supertone pushes the boundaries of creativity, offering an infinite possibility of diverse, expressive voices across various content and entertainment sectors.
